references.text: King David uses the same expression 'goes the way of all the earth' when he is about to die, which refers to humanity's common fate.
Confirms that not one word fell to the ground of all the good words the Lord had spoken to the house of Israel - everything had been fulfilled.
God is not a human being who lies, or a son of man who changes his mind. Does he say something and not do it?
God's word does not return empty, but accomplishes what the Lord desires and fulfills the purpose for which he sent it.
At the temple dedication, Solomon confirms that not one word has fallen to the ground of all the good promises of the Lord through Moses.
We must hold firmly to our confession of hope without wavering, for he who promised is faithful.
The Lord is not slow in keeping his promise, as some understand slowness, but is patient toward you.
Moses is told that his day of death is approaching, just as Joshua here acknowledges that he goes the way of all the earth.
